events.title: Biblical relational-unity / sourcehood comparison is formalized
events.subject: Project biblical research
events.summary: A new comparative sweep identifies 1 Corinthians 12 as a high-density neighbor for unity-without-collapse; 1 Corinthians 8:6 as source-from versus mediation-through grammar; John 17 as relational unity/indwelling; Acts 17 as a corrective against crude localization of Source; and Colossians/Ephesians as both an integration analogue and a Christological counter-fit to assigning every holding-together function to Tim/Father.
